set.body: The paired validation found a material all-run versus training-only signal difference under unmodelled AR(1), driven by a shift in the learned precision target rather than evaluator error. Extend the experiment across temporal autocorrelation, temporal whitening/prewhitening estimation, heteroskedasticity, structured/data-adaptive shrinkage targets, run-specific covariance, support size, and sample size. Derive or simulate when residual reuse preserves the intended target; calibrate LD-t or intervals only after accounting for learned-metric randomness. This research does not block the conservative training-only vertical slice.
set.title: Research: characterize residual-reuse metric target under observation-model misspecification
